sources.citation: Human Obsolescence Index, 2026-Q4 edition. Computed from BLS Employment Projections 2025–35, Microsoft Working-with-AI, and Eloundou et al. (2024). Formula: OBS = round(0.65 × Exposure + 0.35 × Trajectory).
